subject: Questionnaire sync: CAIQ scope boundaries & artifact timeline
messages:
From: Lena Morales <lena.morales@orchidhospital.com>
To: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: Mike Chen <mike.chen@orchidhospital.com>, aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 5 Feb 2026 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: CAIQ kickoff & scope clarifications

Hi Lauren,

Thanks for agreeing to help with Orchid Hospital's CAIQ. We reviewed the initial questionnaire and have a couple of scope questions before we schedule a walk-through:

1) We want to confirm whether our review should include Redwood Private (VPC) vs Redwood Hosted — our procurement notes both.
2) Can you point us to where sample audit logs and retention policy text live so we can validate controls around logging and retention?

Would love a quick 30-minute sync next week to align on which artifacts you can share and ownership for the evidence.

Proposed times: Mon 9–11am PT or Tue 1–4pm PT.

Thanks,
Lena Morales
Director, IT Risk
Orchid Hospital
From: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Lena Morales <lena.morales@orchidhospital.com>
Cc: aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 5 Feb 2026 17:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ kickoff & scope clarifications

Lena — thanks, this is great context.

Short answers up front:
- Scope: we can cover both Hosted and Private. For Private, we’ll note which controls are customer-managed (networking/KMS) vs Redwood-managed.
- Artifacts: we can provide a CAIQ PDF export, SOC2 summary, example logging samples (redacted), and retention policy text.

I can do Tue 2pm PT for a 30-min call. Aditya (cc) will join to confirm logs/retention owners.

Action items before the call:
- Lena: please flag any high-priority CAIQ questions (top 10) so we can prioritize.
- Aditya: can you gather one example syslog and the retention snippet (redacted) and add to the Drive link below before Tue?

Drive link for artifacts (private): https://drive.redwood.com/shared/Orchid-CAIQ-Samples

I’ll send calendar invite and an agenda.

— Lauren
Lauren Bishop
Head of Security Partnerships
Redwood Inference
From: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 6 Feb 2026 09:18:00 -08:00
Subject: Fwd: CAIQ kickoff & scope clarifications — evidence owners

Aditya / Marissa — forwarding Orchid thread.

Please take the following owners:
- Aditya: provide a redacted syslog sample that shows auth/login events, and a short note on log retention policy (where it’s stored, retention length, any backup/archival policy). Put files in the Drive folder and name them orch_syslog_sample_20260206.txt and orch_retention_snippet_20260206.md.
- Marissa: intake CAIQ question list during the call and own the CAIQ PDF export + SOC2 summary artifact upload.

Call details: Tue 10 Feb 2026, 2:00pm PT, 30m — calendar invite to follow.

Please confirm.

— Lauren
From: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Feb 2026 11:27:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: CAIQ kickoff & scope clarifications — evidence owners

Confirmed — I’ll own the CAIQ export and SOC2 summary.

Quick notes for the call prep:
- I uploaded a draft CAIQ export (partial) to the Drive folder: Redwood_CAIC_Summary_2026-02.pdf (placeholder until we complete a full export).
- Aditya: when you upload the syslog sample, include a one-line header with the sample timestamp range and the host role (e.g., gateway-01). That helps Orchid map controls quickly.
- We should have the SOC2 control mapping table ready for any crosswalk questions; I’ll bring a one-page.

Attachments: Redwood_CAIC_Summary_2026-02.pdf (see Drive)

— Marissa
From: Lena Morales <lena.morales@orchidhospital.com>
To: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: Mike Chen <mike.chen@orchidhospital.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Feb 2026 10:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ kickoff & scope clarifications

Lauren / team — thanks, Tue 2pm PT works for us.

We’ll send the top-10 CAIQ items by EOD Mon; the team expects to review the CAIQ and the log sample for authentication controls. Please include any known control gaps (e.g., customer-managed items for Private deployment) on the call so we can flag exceptions early.

See you Tue.

— Lena
